grammar-de-adj-dev-predicative-blau.explanation: The normalization rule mentioned ordinary sentence-initial capitalization but did not state strongly enough that it also applies to suffixless predicative adjectives at the beginning of the sentence.

grammar-de-adj-dev-abbreviation-sog.explanation: The Core Feature rule did not explicitly contrast an abbreviated Surface of a full adjective Lemma, which requires Abbr Yes and Variant null, with a genuinely short Lemma identity.

grammar-de-adj-dev-archaic-hold.explanation: The Surface Feature rule named archaic use but did not give the model an operational contrast between an old poetic adjective and an ordinary current adjective.
